schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 048 - Skills Customization And Invalid States

questions.label: What happens when the bundled skill creator skill is customized?
questions.help: Recommended: bundled skill stays read-only; customization creates a user-global copy so app updates do not overwrite user changes.
options: Bundled read-only; customization creates user-global copy
Copy into user config on first run even if unchanged

questions.label: Which invalid-skill states should Settings distinguish?
questions.help: Recommended: distinguish missing SKILL.md, invalid frontmatter, missing name, missing description, duplicate name, unreadable files, and dependency/source unavailable.
options: Missing SKILL.md, invalid frontmatter, missing name/description, duplicate name, unreadable, and source unavailable
Only missing file and parse error

questions.label: When later promoted, should project-local skills require the FS plugin?
questions.help: Recommended: yes. Project-local skills depend on FS because FS owns project roots, trust, and workspace/project context.
options: Yes; project-local skills require FS plugin
No; skills discovery should read project paths without FS
Only require FS for enabling, not discovery

questions.label: How should invalid skills behave in `$` tagging?
questions.help: Recommended: hide invalid skills from `$` suggestions but show them in Settings with reason and repair actions.
options: Hide from $ suggestions; show in Settings with reason and repair actions

questions.help: Clarify repair actions, duplicate-name resolution, whether plugin-provided invalid skills disable parent plugin, or how user copies relate to bundled updates.
